newsitem.title: MEXICO: Banamex and Bancomer pull ahead in Afores - report.
newsitem.headline: Banamex and Bancomer pull ahead in Afores - report.

text.p: Mexico's two largest banks, Banamex and Bancomer, haved pulled ahead in the race to sign up customers for their private pension funds, a new poll published by Reforma newspaper said on Monday.
The poll, of 400 people in the capital region between April 14 and 15, showed that both Banamex and Bancomer received 24 percent of those who made their decisions.
Bital received 13 percent, while Santander took 12 percent, the poll showed.
The Afore run by Inbursa took six percent, while the other institutions took smaller amounts.
The Afores will go into operation in July and give Mexican workers an alternative to the existing state-run pension system.
The poll also found the most important factor in making the decision of the pension company was the size of commission fees.
